notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers and Sword of the Paruns attached to Saheeli.
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Saheeli's ability, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Resolve both Saheeli abilities, creating two token copies of Gilded Lotus.
Activate both Gilded Lotus tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact/creature using Saheeli's ability.
